text:
ava: heads-up — the inference-kvcache-miss alert has been firing a lot for the last ~2h, primarily p95/p99 spikes around 00:30-01:15 UTC. It's noiseing on the channel and paging some oncall folks.

sam: any correlation with nightly jobs or model rollouts?

ava: looks correlated with nightly embedding refresh jobs (job: embed-backfill). I checked metrics and saw a short-lived jump in kv_cache_miss_rate and decode latency. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/inference-kv-cache?orgId=1

maria: can you paste the prometheus query you used? want to validate in my local grafana panel.

ava: sure — this is the quick query i ran:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (model)
```
also looked at decode p95: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(model_decode_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))`

devon: logs for the timeframe: https://kibana.redwood.ai/app/discover#/query?_g=(time:(from:now-3h,to:now)) — filtered for `service:inference AND kv_cache_miss:true` shows backpressure warnings from the batcher around the same time.

maria: is this causing user-impact or just noisy alerting?

ava: user-impact seems low — error rates and 5xx haven't budged, latency uptick is brief and for lower-priority models. It's mostly noise for SRE oncall.

sam: proposal: temporary 3-hour snooze for the alert and a follow-up to bump threshold from 200 -> 400 misses/min (or change to a rate-based rolling window). Also add an annotation to the alert with the runbook link and responsible owner. Thoughts?

devon: +1 for 3h snooze, but prefer 2h first to avoid hiding a real regression. Could we instead move to alert suppression for the `embed-backfill` job via alertmanager silences filtered by `job=embed-backfill`?

ava: i like that — suppressing alerts when the backfill runs is safer. We can add a label to the backfill job and have alertmanager silence based on `job_label`. Steps: (1) create short silence for 2h while we deploy the label change, (2) if ownership okay, change alert threshold to 350 and set evaluation window to 10m.

oncall-sre: i'm on it — i'll create a 2h silence now for `alertname="inference-kvcache-miss" AND cluster="prod"` and link it here. Creating silence... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ml-bot: Silence created by oncall-sre (duration 2h). Silence ID: s-9a8b7c.

sam: thanks. can someone file a tiny follow-up ticket to track: add job label, update alert threshold, and add runbook annotation? assign to devon + maria. eg: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/OPS-2345

maria: i'll create the ticket and add the playbook steps + links to grafana/kibana/jaeger traces.

ava: thanks all. i'll monitor the next window and follow up if the silence hides anything unexpected. :thumbsup:

devon: quick command snippets for whoever needs to validate after changes:
```
# check kv cache miss rate
curl -g "https://prometheus.redwood.ai/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m]))%20by%20(model)" | jq .

# query alerts
curl -s "https://alertmanager.redwood.ai/api/v2/alerts?silenced=false" | jq '.[] | select(.labels.alertname=="inference-kvcache-miss")'
```
ava: tagging folks who should be aware: @sam @devon @maria — ping me if you want to be added to the follow-up ticket.
